name: Land id
shortDescription: Nationwide parcel and owner info. From $15 per month, or $7 billed annually.
longDescription: Land id maps parcels and owner info. On October 16, 2026 the pricing page listed the base plan at $7 per month per user billed annually, and the app listing also stated $15 per month billed monthly, plus a 7-day trial. Premium adds AI Insights. We did not start a trial.
pricingNotes: Base plan is $15 per month billed monthly, or $7 per month billed annually. 7-day trial.
bestFor: Looking up parcel boundaries and owner info across the United States
notIdealFor: Someone who wants a lasting $0 map
strength: The base plan is $15 per month billed monthly, or $7 per month billed annually, with a 7-day trial.
weakness: There is no lasting free plan, and mailing lists on the pricing page can cost extra.

useCaseFit.find-land: Looks up parcel and owner info nationwide, with a 7-day trial on the paid plan.
